package fixture

// Fixture for txaudit's own test. Stored as .txt so it is not compiled with the tool.

type factory struct{}

type svc struct {
	txManager     manager
	stripeClient  stripe
	notifications chan string
}

type manager interface {
	WithTx(ctx any, fn func(ctx any, f factory) error) error
}

type stripe interface{ Charge(string) error }

func (s *svc) accumulates() error {
	var results []string
	return s.txManager.WithTx(nil, func(ctx any, f factory) error {
		for _, v := range []string{"a", "b"} {
			results = append(results, v)
		}
		return nil
	})
}

func (s *svc) callsOutside() error {
	return s.txManager.WithTx(nil, func(ctx any, f factory) error {
		return s.stripeClient.Charge("cus_1")
	})
}

func (s *svc) spawns() error {
	return s.txManager.WithTx(nil, func(ctx any, f factory) error {
		go func() { _ = 1 }()
		return nil
	})
}

func (s *svc) sends() error {
	return s.txManager.WithTx(nil, func(ctx any, f factory) error {
		s.notifications <- "done"
		return nil
	})
}

func (s *svc) isFine() error {
	var out []string
	return s.txManager.WithTx(nil, func(ctx any, f factory) error {
		// Built inside and assigned out once: a retry replaces it rather than doubling it.
		acc := make([]string, 0, 2)
		for _, v := range []string{"a", "b"} {
			acc = append(acc, v)
		}
		out = acc
		return nil
	})
}
